plugin.name: SquareSoft_Plugin_Controller
plugin.author: OpenAI
plugin.purpose: Central controller for SquareSoft miniwindow plugin layout save/load
plugin.description:
SQUARESOFT PLUGIN CONTROLLER v1.5
IMPORTANT: v1.0 used broad WindowList()/owner discovery as a compatibility fallback. That path has been removed completely because it can destabilize MUSHclient when complex plugins are actively creating/repainting helper miniwindows.
v1.1 only touches: * plugins which explicitly expose the SquareSoft managed-layout API * the known Generic_Chat_Miniwindow adapter
Commands: layout save layout load - monitor-scaled restore (default) layout load exact - raw pixel-for-pixel restore layout path layout save NAME layout load NAME layout inspect layout scale ui plugins
Default file: SquareSoft_UI_Layout.txt

muclient.script:
SELF_ID = GetPluginID() LAYOUT_FORMAT_VERSION = 2 WINDOW_SEP = string.char(30)
-- Fixed registry: no WindowList(), no WindowInfo(..., 23), no scanning arbitrary -- helper windows. This is intentionally conservative for MUSHclient stability. MANAGED_PLUGINS = { { id="91c7e4a23bf84d1aa0e9c562", name="Status Effect Tracker" }, { id="a1e4bf29c1a8477fa19b2201", name="XP / AP / Gold Rates" }, { id="a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c", name="Exit Compass" }, { id="6a941f23b8ce4a2d9e7051bc", name="Travel Shortcuts" }, { id="d47f6a92e1b83c5f0a9e2716", name="HP / MP Gauges" }, { id="c39d5271e8a04f6b9c418823", name="Enemy Bestiary Tracker" }, { id="7f3e21b0a94d4d73b87c34e2", name="World Map Window" }, { id="a7c3e91b4d6f2085c1e73a9d", name="SquareSoft Automapper" } }
CHAT_PLUGIN_ID = "10778718503f0c91106745f5" CHAT_PLUGIN_NAME = "Generic Chat / Communication"
UI_LAYOUT_CONTROLLER_ID = "7b4e91c2a6d34f0ca8e12573"
-- If an older layout file does not contain gutter metadata, these are the -- reference gutters from the bundled 1899x968 canvas / 1920x1080 monitor preset. FALLBACK_GUTTER_LEFT = 390 FALLBACK_GUTTER_RIGHT = 850
-- Typography deliberately scales more gently than window geometry. -- A 4K desktop should not turn 9pt labels into comically huge text. MIN_TYPE_SCALE = 0.85 MAX_TYPE_SCALE = 1.35
function ControllerNote(colour, text) ColourNote(colour or "lime", "", "[Plugin Controller] " .. tostring(text or "")) end
function PluginDirectory() local dir = tostring(GetPluginInfo(SELF_ID, 20) or "") if dir == "" then return "" end local last = dir:sub(-1) if last ~= "\\" and last ~= "/" then dir = dir .. "\\" end return dir end
function SafeProfileName(name) name = tostring(name or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if name == "" then return "" end return (name:gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_")) end
function LayoutPath(profile) local dir = PluginDirectory() if dir == "" then return nil end profile = SafeProfileName(profile) if profile == "" then return dir .. "SquareSoft_UI_Layout.txt" end return dir .. "SquareSoft_UI_Layout_" .. profile .. ".txt" end
function EscapeField(value) local s = tostring(value or "") s = s:gsub("%%", "%%25") s = s:gsub("|", "%%7C") s = s:gsub("\r", "%%0D") s = s:gsub("\n", "%%0A") return s end
function UnescapeField(value) local s = tostring(value or "") s = s:gsub("%%0A", "\n") s = s:gsub("%%0D", "\r") s = s:gsub("%%7[Cc]", "|") s = s:gsub("%%25", "%%") return s end
function SplitPipe(line) local out = {} local start = 1 while true do local p = string.find(line, "|", start, true) if not p then table.insert(out, line:sub(start)) break end table.insert(out, line:sub(start, p - 1)) start = p + 1 end return out end
function SplitWindowNames(text) local out = {} text = tostring(text or "") if text == "" then return out end
local start = 1 while true do local p = string.find(text, WINDOW_SEP, start, true) if not p then local item = text:sub(start) if item ~= "" then table.insert(out, item) end break end
local item = text:sub(start, p - 1) if item ~= "" then table.insert(out, item) end start = p + 1 end
return out end
function WindowExists(name) if not name or name == "" then return false end return WindowInfo(name, 3) ~= nil end
function GetManagedWindows(pluginId) if not IsPluginInstalled(pluginId) then return {} end if PluginSupports(pluginId, "GetManagedLayoutWindows") ~= error_code.eOK then return {} end
local rc, value = CallPlugin(pluginId, "GetManagedLayoutWindows") if rc ~= error_code.eOK then return {} end return SplitWindowNames(value) end
function CaptureWindow(pluginId, displayName, win, kind) if not WindowExists(win) then return nil end
-- Only documented geometry selectors; no owner discovery or global scan. local x = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 10)) local y = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 11)) local w = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 3)) local h = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 4))
if x == nil then x = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 1)) end if y == nil then y = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 2)) end
if x == nil or y == nil or w == nil or h == nil then return nil end
return { kind = kind or "managed", plugin_id = pluginId, plugin_name = displayName, window = win, x = math.floor(x), y = math.floor(y), width = math.floor(w), height = math.floor(h), mode = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 7)) or 0, flags = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 8)) or 0, background = tonumber(WindowInfo(win, 9)) or 0 } end
function CollectLayoutRecords(verbose) local rows = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(MANAGED_PLUGINS) do if IsPluginInstalled(entry.id) then local names = GetManagedWindows(entry.id) if verbose then ControllerNote("cyan", entry.name .. ": " .. tostring(#names) .. " managed window(s)") end
for _, win in ipairs(names) do local row = CaptureWindow(entry.id, entry.name, win, "managed") if row then table.insert(rows, row) end end elseif verbose then ControllerNote("yellow", entry.name .. ": not installed") end end
-- Known adapter for Nick Gammon's Generic_Chat_Miniwindow. Its real miniwindow -- name is its plugin ID. We address that one exact window only. if IsPluginInstalled(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID) and WindowExists(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID) then local row = CaptureWindow( CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, CHAT_PLUGIN_NAME, CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "generic_chat" ) if row then table.insert(rows, row) if verbose then ControllerNote("cyan", CHAT_PLUGIN_NAME .. ": 1 window") end end elseif verbose then ControllerNote("yellow", CHAT_PLUGIN_NAME .. ": not installed/visible") end
return rows end
function ClampNumber(value, lo, hi) value = tonumber(value) or lo if value < lo then return lo end if value > hi then return hi end return value end
function RoundNumber(value) value = tonumber(value) or 0 if value >= 0 then return math.floor(value + 0.5) end return math.ceil(value - 0.5) end
function CurrentOutputSize() return tonumber(GetInfo(281)) or 0, tonumber(GetInfo(280)) or 0 end
-- Monitor resolution is deliberately independent of the current MUSHclient -- window size. This is what makes first-install layout deterministic even if -- MUSHclient happens to be restored/windowed while the suite is installed. function CurrentMonitorSize() local okW, width = pcall(GetSystemMetrics, 0) local okH, height = pcall(GetSystemMetrics, 1)
width = okW and tonumber(width) or 0 height = okH and tonumber(height) or 0
if width > 0 and height > 0 then return width, height end
-- Very old/unusual MUSHclient builds: fall back safely to the current -- output canvas rather than refusing to restore a layout at all. return CurrentOutputSize() end
function ReadGutterLayoutState() if not IsPluginInstalled(UI_LAYOUT_CONTROLLER_ID) then return nil, nil end
if PluginSupports(UI_LAYOUT_CONTROLLER_ID, "GetManagedGutterLayout") ~= error_code.eOK then return nil, nil end
local rc, value = CallPlugin( UI_LAYOUT_CONTROLLER_ID, "GetManagedGutterLayout" )
if rc ~= error_code.eOK then return nil, nil end
local left, right = tostring(value or ""):match("^(-?%d+)%s+(-?%d+)$")
return tonumber(left), tonumber(right) end
function ApplyGutterLayout(meta, geometryScale) if not IsPluginInstalled(UI_LAYOUT_CONTROLLER_ID) then return end
if PluginSupports(UI_LAYOUT_CONTROLLER_ID, "ApplyManagedGutterLayout") ~= error_code.eOK then return end
local left = tonumber(meta and meta.gutter_left) or FALLBACK_GUTTER_LEFT local right = tonumber(meta and meta.gutter_right) or FALLBACK_GUTTER_RIGHT
left = math.max(0, RoundNumber(left * geometryScale)) right = math.max(0, RoundNumber(right * geometryScale))
local rc = CallPlugin( UI_LAYOUT_CONTROLLER_ID, "ApplyManagedGutterLayout", tostring(left) .. "\t" .. tostring(right) )
if rc ~= error_code.eOK then ControllerNote( "yellow", "Layout Controller gutter restore failed (error " .. tostring(rc) .. "); continuing with window placement." ) end end
function ComputeScaleInfo(meta) local actualOutputW, actualOutputH = CurrentOutputSize() local currentMonitorW, currentMonitorH = CurrentMonitorSize()
local sourceOutputW = tonumber(meta and meta.output_width) or actualOutputW local sourceOutputH = tonumber(meta and meta.output_height) or actualOutputH local sourceMonitorW = tonumber(meta and meta.monitor_width) or 0 local sourceMonitorH = tonumber(meta and meta.monitor_height) or 0
local monitorMetadataValid = sourceMonitorW > 0 and sourceMonitorH > 0 and currentMonitorW > 0 and currentMonitorH > 0 and sourceOutputW > 0 and sourceOutputH > 0
local geometry = 1.0 local targetCanvasW = actualOutputW local targetCanvasH = actualOutputH local basis = "output"
if monitorMetadataValid then -- Uniform geometry scale is based ONLY on physical monitor resolution. -- The target MUSHclient canvas is predicted from the reference canvas / -- monitor proportions so a windowed installer does not distort the -- initial placement. Width and height are predicted separately, which -- also preserves edge anchoring on ultrawide/16:10 displays. geometry = math.min( currentMonitorW / sourceMonitorW, currentMonitorH / sourceMonitorH )
targetCanvasW = currentMonitorW * (sourceOutputW / sourceMonitorW) targetCanvasH = currentMonitorH * (sourceOutputH / sourceMonitorH) basis = "monitor"
elseif actualOutputW > 0 and actualOutputH > 0 and sourceOutputW > 0 and sourceOutputH > 0 then -- Backward-compatible fallback for old saved layouts that predate the -- monitor metadata. geometry = math.min( actualOutputW / sourceOutputW, actualOutputH / sourceOutputH ) targetCanvasW = actualOutputW targetCanvasH = actualOutputH end
local typography = ClampNumber( math.sqrt(math.max(0.01, geometry)), MIN_TYPE_SCALE, MAX_TYPE_SCALE )
return { basis = basis, current_width = targetCanvasW, current_height = targetCanvasH, source_width = sourceOutputW, source_height = sourceOutputH, actual_output_width = actualOutputW, actual_output_height = actualOutputH, source_monitor_width = sourceMonitorW, source_monitor_height = sourceMonitorH, current_monitor_width = currentMonitorW, current_monitor_height = currentMonitorH, geometry = geometry, typography = typography } end
function ScaledAxisPosition(startPos, size, sourceExtent, currentExtent, scale) local center = startPos + size / 2 local newSize = size * scale
-- Edge windows stay attached to their edge. Center windows stay around -- the center. This behaves much better than blindly multiplying X/Y on -- ultrawide, 16:10, 16:9, and portrait-ish client areas. if center <= sourceExtent * 0.34 then return startPos * scale, newSize elseif center >= sourceExtent * 0.66 then local farMargin = sourceExtent - (startPos + size) return currentExtent - farMargin * scale - newSize, newSize end
local centerOffset = center - sourceExtent / 2 local newCenter = currentExtent / 2 + centerOffset * scale return newCenter - newSize / 2, newSize end
function ScaleLayoutRecord(r, scaleInfo) local x, w = ScaledAxisPosition( r.x, r.width, scaleInfo.source_width, scaleInfo.current_width, scaleInfo.geometry )
local y, h = ScaledAxisPosition( r.y, r.height, scaleInfo.source_height, scaleInfo.current_height, scaleInfo.geometry )
local copy = {} for k, v in pairs(r) do copy[k] = v end
copy.x = RoundNumber(x) copy.y = RoundNumber(y) copy.width = math.max(1, RoundNumber(w)) copy.height = math.max(1, RoundNumber(h))
return copy end
function ScaleKnownPluginFonts(typeScale) local s = ClampNumber(typeScale, MIN_TYPE_SCALE, MAX_TYPE_SCALE)
local function size(base, lo, hi) return math.max( lo or 5, math.min( hi or 32, RoundNumber(base * s) ) ) end
-- These are fixed, known windows/font IDs. No global miniwindow scanning. -- Enemy Tracker is intentionally excluded because it already has its own -- responsive font-density system based on card width. -- Automapper is excluded because map-node type is tied to map zoom. -- World Map is excluded because its 9x9 cell metrics are intentionally fixed.
local id = "91c7e4a23bf84d1aa0e9c562" -- Status if WindowExists(id) then pcall(WindowFont, id, "body"..id, "Lucida Console", size(9, 7, 13)) pcall(WindowFont, id, "title"..id, "Lucida Console", size(9, 7, 13), true) end
id = "a1e4bf29c1a8477fa19b2201" -- XP/AP/Gold if WindowExists(id) then pcall(WindowFont, id, "body"..id, "Lucida Console", size(9, 7, 13)) pcall(WindowFont, id, "title"..id, "Lucida Console", size(9, 7, 13), true) end
if WindowExists("ExitWindow") then pcall(WindowFont, "ExitWindow", "ExitWindowFont", "Arial", size(11, 9, 15), true) pcall(WindowFont, "ExitWindow", "ExitWindowSmallFont", "Arial", size(9, 7, 13)) end
id = "6a941f23b8ce4a2d9e7051bc" -- Travel if WindowExists(id) then pcall(WindowFont, id, "body"..id, "Lucida Console", size(10, 8, 14)) pcall(WindowFont, id, "title"..id, "Lucida Console", size(9, 7, 13), true) end
local gauges = "d47f6a92e1b83c5f0a9e2716" local hp = gauges .. "_hp" local mp = gauges .. "_mp" if WindowExists(hp) then pcall(WindowFont, hp, "title"..hp, "Lucida Console", size(9, 7, 13), true) pcall(WindowFont, hp, "body"..hp, "Lucida Console", size(12, 9, 16), true) end if WindowExists(mp) then pcall(WindowFont, mp, "title"..mp, "Lucida Console", size(9, 7, 13), true) pcall(WindowFont, mp, "body"..mp, "Lucida Console", size(12, 9, 16), true) end if IsPluginInstalled(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID) and PluginSupports(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "ApplyManagedTypography") == error_code.eOK then local rc = CallPlugin( CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "ApplyManagedTypography", tostring(s) )
if rc ~= error_code.eOK then ControllerNote( "yellow", "Chat typography scaling skipped (error " .. tostring(rc) .. ")." ) end end
end
function SaveLayout(profile) local path = LayoutPath(profile) if not path then ControllerNote("red", "Could not determine the controller plugin directory.") return false end
ControllerNote("cyan", "Capturing managed UI layout...") local rows = CollectLayoutRecords(false)
local f, err = io.open(path, "w") if not f then ControllerNote("red", "Could not write layout file: " .. tostring(err)) return false end
f:write("# SquareSoft UI Layout\n") f:write("# format=" .. tostring(LAYOUT_FORMAT_VERSION) .. "\n") f:write("# generated=" .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") .. "\n") f:write("# output_width=" .. tostring(GetInfo(281) or "") .. "\n") f:write("# output_height=" .. tostring(GetInfo(280) or "") .. "\n")
local monitorWidth, monitorHeight = CurrentMonitorSize() f:write("# monitor_width=" .. tostring(monitorWidth or "") .. "\n") f:write("# monitor_height=" .. tostring(monitorHeight or "") .. "\n")
local gutterLeft, gutterRight = ReadGutterLayoutState() if gutterLeft ~= nil then f:write("# gutter_left=" .. tostring(gutterLeft) .. "\n") end if gutterRight ~= nil then f:write("# gutter_right=" .. tostring(gutterRight) .. "\n") end
f:write("# Fields: WINDOW|kind|plugin_id|plugin_name|window_name|x|y|width|height|mode|flags|background\n")
for _, r in ipairs(rows) do f:write( "WINDOW|" .. EscapeField(r.kind) .. "|" .. EscapeField(r.plugin_id) .. "|" .. EscapeField(r.plugin_name) .. "|" .. EscapeField(r.window) .. "|" .. tostring(r.x) .. "|" .. tostring(r.y) .. "|" .. tostring(r.width) .. "|" .. tostring(r.height) .. "|" .. tostring(r.mode) .. "|" .. tostring(r.flags) .. "|" .. tostring(r.background) .. "\n" ) end
f:close()
ControllerNote("lime", "Saved " .. tostring(#rows) .. " windows.") Note(path) return true end
function ParseLayoutFile(path) local f, err = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return nil, nil, err end
local rows = {} local meta = {}
for line in f:lines() do local key, value = line:match("^#%s*([%w_]+)%s*=%s*(.-)%s*$") if key and value then meta[key] = value elseif line:sub(1, 7) == "WINDOW|" then local p = SplitPipe(line)
if #p >= 12 then local row = { kind = UnescapeField(p[2]), plugin_id = UnescapeField(p[3]), plugin_name = UnescapeField(p[4]), window = UnescapeField(p[5]), x = tonumber(p[6]), y = tonumber(p[7]), width = tonumber(p[8]), height = tonumber(p[9]), mode = tonumber(p[10]), flags = tonumber(p[11]), background = tonumber(p[12]) }
if row.plugin_id ~= "" and row.window ~= "" and row.x and row.y and row.width and row.height then table.insert(rows, row) end end end end
f:close() return rows, meta end
function ApplyManagedLayout(r) if not IsPluginInstalled(r.plugin_id) then return false, "plugin not installed" end
if PluginSupports(r.plugin_id, "ApplyManagedLayout") ~= error_code.eOK then return false, "layout API missing" end
local payload = r.window .. "\t" .. tostring(math.floor(r.x)) .. "\t" .. tostring(math.floor(r.y)) .. "\t" .. tostring(math.floor(r.width)) .. "\t" .. tostring(math.floor(r.height))
local rc, result = CallPlugin(r.plugin_id, "ApplyManagedLayout", payload) if rc ~= error_code.eOK then return false, "plugin returned " .. tostring(rc) end
if tostring(result or "") ~= "ok" then return false, tostring(result or "layout rejected") end
return true end
function SetOtherPluginVariable(pluginId, key, value) local rc = CallPlugin(pluginId, "SetVariable", tostring(key), tostring(value)) return rc == error_code.eOK end
function SaveOtherPluginState(pluginId) pcall(function() CallPlugin(pluginId, "SaveState") end) end
function ApplyGenericChatLayout(r) if IsPluginInstalled(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID) and PluginSupports(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "ApplyManagedLayout") == error_code.eOK then local payload = r.window .. "\t" .. tostring(math.floor(r.x)) .. "\t" .. tostring(math.floor(r.y)) .. "\t" .. tostring(math.floor(r.width)) .. "\t" .. tostring(math.floor(r.height))
local rc, result = CallPlugin( CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "ApplyManagedLayout", payload )
if rc == error_code.eOK and tostring(result or "") == "ok" then return true end end
if not IsPluginInstalled(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID) then return false, "chat plugin not installed" end if not WindowExists(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID) then return false, "chat window not created" end
local background = tonumber(WindowInfo(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, 9)) or tonumber(r.background) or ColourNameToRGB("black")
local mode = tonumber(r.mode) or tonumber(WindowInfo(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, 7)) or miniwin.pos_top_left
local flags = tonumber(r.flags) or tonumber(WindowInfo(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, 8)) or miniwin.create_absolute_location
WindowResize( CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, math.max(1, math.floor(r.width)), math.max(1, math.floor(r.height)), background )
WindowPosition( CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, math.floor(r.x), math.floor(r.y), mode, flags )
-- Persist the size and movewindow state in the chat plugin's own state file. -- This avoids replacing/modifying the user's customized chat plugin. SetOtherPluginVariable(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "WINDOW_WIDTH", math.floor(r.width)) SetOtherPluginVariable(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "WINDOW_HEIGHT", math.floor(r.height)) SetOtherPluginVariable(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "mw_" .. CHAT_PLUGIN_ID .. "_windowx", math.floor(r.x)) SetOtherPluginVariable(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "mw_" .. CHAT_PLUGIN_ID .. "_windowy", math.floor(r.y)) SetOtherPluginVariable(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "mw_" .. CHAT_PLUGIN_ID .. "_windowmode", mode) SetOtherPluginVariable(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "mw_" .. CHAT_PLUGIN_ID .. "_windowflags", flags) SaveOtherPluginState(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID)
return true end
function LoadLayoutInternal(profile, exactPixels) local path = LayoutPath(profile) if not path then ControllerNote("red", "Could not determine the controller plugin directory.") return false end
local rows, meta, err = ParseLayoutFile(path) if not rows then ControllerNote("red", "Could not read layout file: " .. tostring(err)) Note(path) return false end
local scaleInfo = ComputeScaleInfo(meta)
if exactPixels then scaleInfo.geometry = 1.0 scaleInfo.typography = 1.0 -- Exact mode deliberately uses the source canvas for positions. scaleInfo.current_width = scaleInfo.source_width scaleInfo.current_height = scaleInfo.source_height end
local applied = 0 local failed = 0
-- Restore the gutter reservation before placing windows on top of it. ApplyGutterLayout(meta, scaleInfo.geometry)
for _, original in ipairs(rows) do local r = exactPixels and original or ScaleLayoutRecord(original, scaleInfo)
local ok, why
if r.kind == "generic_chat" and r.plugin_id == CHAT_PLUGIN_ID then ok, why = ApplyGenericChatLayout(r) else ok, why = ApplyManagedLayout(r) end
if ok then applied = applied + 1 else failed = failed + 1 ControllerNote( "yellow", "Skipped " .. tostring(r.plugin_name) .. " / " .. tostring(r.window) .. " (" .. tostring(why or "unknown error") .. ")" ) end end
if not exactPixels then ScaleKnownPluginFonts(scaleInfo.typography) end
Redraw()
local modeText = exactPixels and "EXACT" or "ADAPTIVE" ControllerNote( "lime", modeText .. " layout: loaded " .. tostring(applied) .. " windows" .. (failed > 0 and ("; " .. tostring(failed) .. " skipped.") or ".") )
if not exactPixels then if scaleInfo.basis == "monitor" then ControllerNote( "gray", string.format( "Monitor %dx%d -> %dx%d; reference canvas %dx%d -> target %.0fx%.0f; current output %dx%d; geometry %.3fx, type %.3fx", scaleInfo.source_monitor_width, scaleInfo.source_monitor_height, scaleInfo.current_monitor_width, scaleInfo.current_monitor_height, scaleInfo.source_width, scaleInfo.source_height, scaleInfo.current_width, scaleInfo.current_height, scaleInfo.actual_output_width, scaleInfo.actual_output_height, scaleInfo.geometry, scaleInfo.typography ) ) else ControllerNote( "gray", string.format( "No monitor metadata; output fallback %dx%d -> %dx%d; geometry %.3fx, type %.3fx", scaleInfo.source_width, scaleInfo.source_height, scaleInfo.current_width, scaleInfo.current_height, scaleInfo.geometry, scaleInfo.typography ) ) end end
Note(path) return true end
function LoadLayout(profile) return LoadLayoutInternal(profile or "", false) end
function LoadLayoutExact(profile) return LoadLayoutInternal(profile or "", true) end
function LayoutInspectAlias() ControllerNote("cyan", "Safe layout inspection:") local rows = CollectLayoutRecords(true)
for _, r in ipairs(rows) do Note( string.format( " %-24s x=%d y=%d %dx%d [%s]", tostring(r.plugin_name):sub(1,24), r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height, r.kind ) ) end
ControllerNote("cyan", tostring(#rows) .. " window(s) would be saved.") end
function LayoutSaveAlias(name, line, wildcards) SaveLayout((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or "") end
function LayoutLoadAlias(name, line, wildcards) local arg = tostring((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or "") local lowered = arg:lower()
if lowered == "exact" then LoadLayoutExact("") elseif lowered == "scaled" or lowered == "auto" or lowered == "adaptive" then LoadLayout("") else LoadLayout(arg) end end
function LayoutScaleAlias() local path = LayoutPath("") local rows, meta, err = ParseLayoutFile(path) if not rows then ControllerNote("red", "Could not read layout file: " .. tostring(err)) return end
local s = ComputeScaleInfo(meta) if s.basis == "monitor" then ControllerNote( "cyan", string.format( "Monitor %dx%d -> %dx%d; reference canvas %dx%d -> target %.0fx%.0f; current output %dx%d; geometry %.3fx, type %.3fx", s.source_monitor_width, s.source_monitor_height, s.current_monitor_width, s.current_monitor_height, s.source_width, s.source_height, s.current_width, s.current_height, s.actual_output_width, s.actual_output_height, s.geometry, s.typography ) ) else ControllerNote( "yellow", string.format( "No monitor metadata; output fallback %dx%d -> %dx%d; geometry %.3fx, type %.3fx", s.source_width, s.source_height, s.current_width, s.current_height, s.geometry, s.typography ) ) end end
function LayoutPathAlias() ControllerNote("cyan", "Default layout file:") Note(LayoutPath("") or "(unknown)") end
function PluginStatusAlias() ControllerNote("cyan", "Managed plugin status:")
for _, entry in ipairs(MANAGED_PLUGINS) do local installed = IsPluginInstalled(entry.id) local api = installed and PluginSupports(entry.id, "ApplyManagedLayout") == error_code.eOK
Note( " " .. entry.name .. " : " .. (not installed and "not installed" or (api and "installed / layout-aware" or "installed / needs layout-api copy")) ) end
Note( " " .. CHAT_PLUGIN_NAME .. " : " .. (IsPluginInstalled(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID) and "installed / adapter" or "not installed") ) end
function OnPluginInstall() ControllerNote("lime", "v1.5 ready. Monitor-based layout scaling is enabled by default.") end
